assistant|strut_your_mutt_date: 'Strut Your Mutt' takes place Saturday, September 18, 2023 (on 2023-09-18)
assistant|strut_your_mutt_location: 'Strut Your Mutt' is held at Exposition Park, Los Angeles, CA, near the LA Memorial Coliseum
assistant|strut_your_mutt_time: 'Strut Your Mutt' runs 7:00 AM - 12:00 PM; registration and check-in begin at 7:00 AM, walk starts at 9:00 AM
assistant|strut_your_mutt_distance: 'Strut Your Mutt' offers 1-mile or 3-mile walk routes, stroller-friendly and suitable for all ages
assistant|strut_your_mutt_purpose: 'Strut Your Mutt' raises funds and awareness for animal welfare organizations in LA, focusing on rescue, rehabilitation, and adoption
assistant|strut_your_mutt_registration: 'Strut Your Mutt' registration is $25 per adult, $15 per child (ages 5-12), free for children under 5; registering by September 1st includes a complimentary t-shirt and goodie bag
assistant|strut_your_mutt_participating_: 'Strut Your Mutt' participating organizations include LA Animal Services, The Humane Society of the United States, and ASPCA Los Angeles
assistant|strut_your_mutt_auction_items: 'Strut Your Mutt' silent auction features pet-themed packages, exclusive experiences, luxury pet items, unique pet services, and autographed pet-themed items
assistant|strut_your_mutt_raffle_prizes: Past 'Strut Your Mutt' raffle prizes included pet-friendly getaways, pet pampering packages, pet gear and accessories, experiences, and cash prizes
assistant|strut_your_mutt_special_items: Special 'Strut Your Mutt' items to look out for: exclusive pet portrait sessions, private dog training sessions, pet-friendly weekend getaways, autographed pet-themed art, and VIP pet experiences
assistant|event_advice: Advised arriving early to browse auction items and raffle prizes and setting a bidding budget for a fun, responsible experience
